lessons: CORRECTNESS: Step 2 said Hebrew is 'visually larger' than Latin at the same size; the reference file said the opposite. Measured from the google/fonts TTFs with fontTools: Hebrew letters sit between the Latin x-height and cap height (Heebo mem 0.59 vs H 0.71 em), so Hebrew reads SMALLER. Fixed and the reference metrics table replaced with measured values (the old x-height column was unsourced and off by up to 0.04 em; Noto Sans Hebrew is not 'Hebrew only').

CORRECTNESS: font stack 'var(--font-hebrew), var(--font-latin)' put sans-serif mid-list and Heebo (which has Latin glyphs) first, so Inter never rendered. Now Latin-first: 'Inter', 'Heebo', ..., sans-serif. Reference rule 'Hebrew font first' corrected. Gotcha calling Rubik/Heebo 'system fonts' corrected.

CORRECTNESS: metadata display_description (he+en) still said DD/MM/YYYY after 1.4.0 moved the body to dot-separated dates; fixed. Live FAQ also still said DD/MM/YYYY and 'dir=auto on a single container' (the body says per element); SQL in the report.
